provenance.name: Online Retail II (UCI)
provenance.citation: Chen, D. (2019). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
provenance.notes: All transactions of a UK-based online gift retailer, 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09, as two overlapping yearly sheets.

split.strategy: chronological with 7-day embargo, one item hidden per test basket
split.notes: 9.9% of hidden products never appear in training and count as misses.

models.name: Bestsellers
models.notes: The five most frequently bought products not already in the basket.

models.name: Item co-occurrence
models.notes: Highest P(item | basket item); no mining and no thresholds.

models.name: Rules + bestseller fallback
models.notes: Rule recommendations first; any empty slots filled with bestsellers.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_temporal_split
runtime_assertions.detail: Last training timestamp 2011-08-31 17:30:00 precedes first test timestamp 2011-09-08 08:56:00 by 7 days 15:26:00; embargo of 6D required.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_disjoint
runtime_assertions.detail: 789,736 training and 203,765 test row indices compared; 0 appear in both.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_no_shared_invoices
runtime_assertions.detail: 32,126 training and 7,012 test invoices compared; 0 in both.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_hidden_item_not_visible
runtime_assertions.detail: 6,548 test baskets checked; the hidden item was visible to the model in 0.
